briefdescription.para: Parsed and validated parameters for a paginated, case-insensitive search.

detaileddescription.para:
Construction from a JSON body both extracts the fields and reports, through the success flag, whether the body is well formed and safe. filter and order_by end up as SQL identifiers in the generated statement (they cannot be bound), so they are restricted to plain identifiers; the remaining values are bound as parameters by the Entity builders.
Entity::buildSearchStatement
